dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent O-shaped structures are visible on the posterior-lateral flank, characterized by dark outer perimeters transitioning sharply to lighter-toned interior centers with near-circular geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of irregular, high-intensity white blobs concentrated along the dorsal ridge, forming a near-continuous cluster of solid-color pixels with minimal internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse triangle, while a larger quadrilateral is formed by connecting these centroids to the primary high-intensity dorsal blob.

other_distinctive_markers: A jagged, high-contrast white linear band extends horizontally across the mid-dorsal region, separating the dark dorsal field from the lateral annuli-patterned region.
